channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Caiado diz que categorizará facções como terroristas e fará combate até com Forças Armadas
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that Lula and Bolsonaro have reached their ceiling of rejection, positioning himself as having a clear path forward. He said he would classify criminal factions as terrorist organizations and combat them using the Armed Forces if necessary. Caiado presented himself as an alternative to the two dominant political poles currently in contention.

item.title: Caiado diz que, se eleito, encaminhará reformas ao Congresso no 1º dia, junto com anistia
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, former governor of Goiás and PSD presidential pre-candidate, stated that if elected, he would send reforms to Congress on the first day of his government, including labor, political, administrative reforms and a review of the tax reform. He also mentioned advancing an amnesty, though without specifying its scope. The remarks were made in an interview with Band TV's Canal Livre, aired Sunday night.

item.title: Aliados de Haddad aumentam críticas a Sabesp para atingir Tarcísio
item.description: Opposition lawmakers, mainly from PT and PSOL, intensified criticism of the Sabesp privatization, which they associate with Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’ agenda. Their complaints aim to pressure the state government and undermine public support for the Republican administration. The mobilization is part of a broader strategy to weaken the governor ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Os limites da diplomacia de facção de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is leveraging the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist groups to portray himself as tough on crime, but this is more about gaining international visibility through ideological alignment with Trump than offering a real solution. His faction-based diplomacy, driven by political affinity rather than national interest, is ineffective against organized crime and may strain relations with the Brazilian government without delivering clear electoral gains.

item.title: Torcedores do Brasil gritam nome de Neymar após empate do Panamá. Veja vídeo
item.description: Brazilian fans chanted Neymar's name after Panama equalized against Brazil in a friendly at Maracanã, despite the star being sidelined with a calf injury. Neymar, recovering from a grade 2 calf strain, did not play but remains a symbolic figure for supporters. Brazil will travel to the U.S. for a final friendly vs. Egypt before opening the World Cup against Morocco.

item.title: Com gol de falta, Panamá empata amistoso contra o Brasil; confira
item.description: Panama drew 1-1 with Brazil in an international friendly at Maracanã, with Amir Murillo scoring from a free kick in the 14th minute after the ball deflected off Matheus Cunha. Vinícius Júnior had opened the scoring for Brazil in under a minute. The match ended in a draw, showcasing Panama’s effective set-piece execution.

item.title: Fim da escala 6×1 avança, e indústria alerta para palavra-chave: produtividade
item.description: The Chamber approved a PEC banning the 6×1 work schedule and reducing the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours, with a transition period of up to 14 months. While popular and heavily promoted by the Lula government as a well-being initiative, industry leaders warn that without productivity gains, the measure risks stagnating or reducing per capita income, noting Brazil’s productivity growth has been zero or negative since 1990 excluding agriculture.

item.title: Governo Lula prorroga subsídio de R$ 1,12 por litro de diesel até dezembro
item.description: The Lula government extended the diesel subsidy of R$ 1.12 per liter until December 31 through a provisional measure issued on Saturday the 30th. The measure aims to stabilize price and supply of the fuel amid a supply shock caused by the Middle East conflict, benefiting authorized producers and importers by ANP. The National Congress has up to 120 days to review the measure.

item.title: MPF arquiva investigação sobre suposta incitação a atentado contra Lula
item.description: The Federal Prosecutor's Office (MPF) archived an investigation against an Instagram user who lamented that President Lula had not suffered an attack in 2022. The agency determined the comment, while offensive, did not constitute incitement to murder because it lacked a clear, specific, and determined call to action for others to commit homicide. The decision affirms that generic expressions of violent wishes, however reprehensible, do not meet the legal threshold for incitement.

item.title: Alcolumbre quer recompor relação com Lula, diz José Guimarães
item.description: Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães stated that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) should rebuild his relationship with President Lula (PT) and will not obstruct the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule. Guimarães added that the government is already working on political articulation to secure congressional support for the proposal.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Esquerda mineira cobra arbitragem de Lula em definição de candidatura | AGORA CNN
item.description: The left in Minas Gerais is urging President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to intervene in defining the 2026 presidential candidacy, calling for arbitration to prevent internal divisions and unify progressive forces. The request comes amid rising tensions between PT factions and allies over who should lead the ticket, with some fearing a fractured primary could benefit the right. The demand reflects the Minas Gerais left’s concern for electoral unity and competitiveness in the national political landscape.

item.title: Caiado afasta desvinculação de aposentadoria: 'Não vou tirar essa prerrogativa do aposentado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, former governor of Goiás and presidential pre-candidate, stated he will not remove the link between retirement benefits and minimum wage adjustments, reaffirming his commitment to retirees' social security. The comment was made during an interview on Band TV's Canal Livre program, in response to questions about austerity proposals.

item.title: As dificuldades do PT para resolver o palanque em MG a poucos meses das eleições
item.description: The PT is struggling to define its candidate for governor of Minas Gerais after the failed attempt to launch Rodrigo Pacheco. The current bet is on former Contagem mayor Marília Campos, who leads Senate polls but resists abandoning her legislative bid. Lula is expected to personally intervene to convince her; otherwise, the party will turn to federal deputy Reginaldo Lopes as a backup option.

item.title: A trágica previsão para o Brasil na Copa, segundo economistas do Goldman
item.description: Goldman Sachs economists project Brazil will lose to Argentina in the 2026 World Cup semifinals, with Argentina then losing to Spain in the final in New York. The model gives Spain a 26% chance to win, France 19%, Argentina 14%, and Brazil only 8%, aligning with the historical pattern that the World Cup returns to Europe after a South American victory.

item.title: Com chapas com Gleisi e Moro, Lula e Flávio definem palanques no Paraná
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro have defined their presidential slates in Paraná for the 2026 election, following the launch of pre-candidacies by allies, including tickets featuring Gleisi Hoffmann and Sergio Moro. The move aims to consolidate political support in the state, with Lula relying on the PT base and Flávio on Bolsonarist opposition. The definitions, solidified since Friday, strengthen regional electoral structures.

item.title: Governadora do DF é internada com pneumotórax e passa por procedimento médico
item.description: The governor of the Federal District, Celina Leão (PP), was hospitalized after being diagnosed with pneumothorax and underwent a pleural drainage procedure at a private hospital in Brasília. She remains under observation in the ICU and canceled her weekend agenda as a reelection candidate. Former governor Ibaneis Rocha (MDB), now a Senate candidate, publicly expressed support for her recovery.

item.title: O conselho de Michel Temer a Aécio Neves sobre a disputa ao Planalto
item.description: Michel Temer advised Aécio Neves to propose a major republican pact to pacify the nation and correct its course amid a wave of corruption scandals. Temer warned that breaking polarization would not be easy, especially with the MDB distancing itself from a potential Tucano presidential ticket. The PSDB-Cidadania Federation backs Aécio’s pre-candidacy as a centrist alternative, seeking support from figures like Ciro Gomes and Tasso Jereissati to counter the PT-Bolsonaro divide.

item.title: Lula enfrenta jogo duro em negociação com o agronegócio
item.description: Lula is seeking to improve his image among agribusiness by proposing the renegotiation of up to 180 billion reais in rural debt, though facing resistance from his economic team over the terms. At the same time, he is launching credit lines for app-based drivers and truckers—groups historically distant from the PT—to broaden his electoral base. His absence from Agrishow, represented only by Vice President Alckmin, was seen as inadequate by the sector, which prioritizes debt renegotiation over other measures.

item.title: Visita de deputado do PL a universidade acaba em discussão no CE
item.description: State Deputy Carmelo Neto (PL-CE) visited the Regional University of Cariri (URCA) in Crato/CE on Saturday, May 30, 2026, criticizing the building's structural conditions, including leaks, broken windows, and fire hazards. His visit, as a pre-candidate for federal deputy, sparked debate with professors and staff who objected to his unauthorized access to campus areas. Carmelo blamed the PT-led governments and urged the video to be shared to expose the state of education in Ceará.

item.title: A votação simbólica não é a vilã
item.description: Folha de S.Paulo published a critical article on the use of symbolic voting in the Brazilian Congress, arguing that the procedure undermines legislative legitimacy and transparency. The piece contends that, despite criticisms, symbolic voting should not be seen as the main cause of institutional problems, but rather as a symptom of deeper political dynamics.

item.title: Flávio Dino cancela ida ao ‘Gilmarpalooza’ após fratura e rompimento de ligamento no pé
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino canceled his in-person participation in the 14th Lisbon Forum (Gilmarpalooza) due to a foot fracture and ligament rupture from a domestic accident. Despite his absence, he published his intended remarks titled 'Four Theses for a Transformative Constitutionalism in Brazil', arguing that the 1988 Constitution should guide the state in guaranteeing social rights, that the judiciary must use structural measures to overcome historical blockages, act as a bulwark against democratic backsliding, and regulate digital platforms to counter hate speech and misinformation.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro usa vídeo de IA para criticar Lula por fala sobre PCC e CV
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) shared an AI-generated video depicting Lula wearing high heels and a shirt insulting Trump, to criticize the government’s opposition to the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist groups. The video lacked explicit labeling as AI-generated, violating new TSE rules requiring clear disclosure of synthetic content and banning its circulation three days before and one day after elections. The Brazilian government fears the designation could justify U.S. military intervention.

item.title: Vereadores de BH criticam ato da torcida organizada do Atlético-MG
item.description: Bolsonarist city councilors in Belo Horizonte criticized the mobilization of Atlético-MG's organized fan group FAR against the honorary title being granted to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, labeling the group as 'left-wing troublemakers'. FAR retaliated by accusing the councilors of intimidation and vowing a 'giant' turnout, while right-wing supporters of the club announced they would bring large flags to show support for the honor.

item.title: EUA citam narcoterrorismo em ataque a navio no Pacífico que deixou três mortos
item.description: The U.S. military attacked a vessel in the Eastern Pacific on May 30, killing three men identified as narcoterrorists. The strike was part of Operation Southern Lance launched by the Trump administration, which has reportedly caused over 200 deaths since September. The recent designation of Brazilian criminal groups PCC and Comando Vermelho as narco-terrorist organizations raises concerns in the Lula government about potential pretexts for U.S. military action in Brazil.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro deve lançar primeiras propostas de governo nos próximos dias
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is set to unveil the first proposals of his government plan in the coming days, following his visit to Donald Trump at the White House and reversing the negative agenda from the Banco Master scandal. The senator aims to counter perceptions of lacking ideas and energize his base on social media with positive content.

item.title: Google veta impulsionamento eleitoral nas eleições de 2026
item.description: Google has decided to maintain its ban on political advertising in Brazil for the 2026 elections, as it did in the 2024 municipal elections, citing legal uncertainty from TSE regulations. The restriction applies to YouTube, Google Search, and the Display Network, preventing candidates, parties, and federations from paying for political ads. The move could cost the company up to R$ 200 million in revenue and will have a greater impact than in 2024 due to the larger scale of national and state-level races.

item.title: “Sou criminalizada por ser amiga do filho do presidente Lula”
item.description: Businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger states she introduced businessman Antônio Camilo, known as 'Careca do INSS', to President Lula's son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), as a courteous gesture in a social setting, with no commercial intent. She expresses surprise at being criminalized for the friendship, denying any involvement in illegal schemes or influence peddling.

item.title: A exceção entre maioria de evangélicos no time de Carlo Ancelotti para Copa
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti's Brazil squad for the friendly against Panama features a majority of evangelical players, including stars like Alisson, Neymar, Vinícius Júnior, and Raphinha. Only Marquinhos is identified as Catholic, while Casemiro describes himself only as 'Christian' and Danilo (Flamengo) did not comment on his religion. Ancelotti himself is a devout Catholic and follower of Saint Padre Pio.

item.title: Jurídico do PT vê dor de cabeça no TSE por pacote de bondades de Lula
item.description: PT-affiliated lawyers warn that Lula's recent social benefit package, including 'Gás do Povo' and the second phase of 'Desenrola,' could be seen by the TSE as political and economic abuse of power, citing the Roraima case where similar programs led to candidate removals. While the defense argues these are legitimate public policies, the risk remains if voting patterns shift significantly or if the TSE interprets benefits as conditioned on electoral support. Electoral law bans free donations during election years, but the line between legitimate policy and illicit campaigning depends on contextual nuances.

item.title: Governo Lula prorroga subsídios para conter alta dos combustíveis
item.description: The Lula government extended fuel subsidies and tax exemptions for diesel, cooking gas, aviation kerosene, and biodiesel through a provisional measure, presidential decree, and Ministry of Finance ordinance published between November 29 and 30. The move aims to curb rising fuel prices in Brazil.

item.title: MPF abre inquérito para investigar atuação do governo Lula na fiscalização das bets
item.description: The Federal Prosecutor's Office (MPF) has opened an inquiry to investigate the Lula government's oversight of online betting, focusing on compliance with Laws No. 14.790/2023 and 13.756/2018 by the Ministry of Finance. The probe also assesses the effectiveness of the public health system in treating and preventing pathological gambling, with a one-year duration.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha diz que apresentou Careca do INSS “por educação”
item.description: Businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger confirmed she introduced Lulinha, President Lula’s eldest son, to businessman Antônio Camilo (‘Careca do INSS’) in a social context with no commercial intent. She also disclosed a R$1.5 million consulting contract with Camilo on medicinal cannabis regulation and denied mediating business between him and Lulinha or receiving third-party funding for a trip to Finland with Lulinha.

item.title: As aplicações de radioterapia de Lula
item.description: Lula has completed five of the fifteen planned radiotherapy sessions to treat scalp carcinoma at the Sírio Libanês Hospital in Brasília. The two-minute sessions are being conducted daily by his own choice. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Fórum de Lisboa se globaliza com recorde de nomes internacionais
item.description: The 14th Lisbon Forum, founded by STF Minister Gilmar Mendes, will feature a record number of international speakers in 2026, including experts from 11 countries such as Nobel laureate Joel Mokyr and Pulitzer winner Thomas Friedman. The event, previously focused on Luso-Brazilian topics, now addresses global themes like the new international order, technology, and sovereignty. The decline in Brazilian officials’ participation is attributed to the 2026 electoral year, with many officeholders stepping down to run for office.

item.title: Elecciones Colombia 2026 | Cepeda en su entrevista final con Coronell: “Hay obstinación en no querer escuchar lo que digo y lo que represento”
item.description: Left-wing candidate Iván Cepeda, in his final interview with journalist Daniel Coronell, describes himself as a committed democrat and rejects the framing of Colombia's political divide as communism versus a pure democratic vision, calling it a 'falsehood' that needs to be dispelled. He laments an 'obstinacy in not wanting to hear what I say and what I represent', suggesting institutional or media resistance to his message. The interview took place at 8 p.m. and was presented as a final appearance ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais: como está a disputa Lula x Flávio após números da última semana
item.description: The BTG Nexus and Meio/Ideia polls show Lula expanding his lead over Flávio Bolsonaro following the Banco Master scandal and leaked audios with Daniel Vorcaro. In a potential runoff, Lula holds 46.5% to Flávio’s 41.4%, while in the first round he leads 38.5% to 31.5%. Flávio’s support has declined, particularly among wealthier and center-right voters, with many shifting to undecided, blank, or null votes—though he remains the main right-wing candidate.

item.title: Visão prejudicada
item.description: The Bolsonaro family allegedly acted twice with the U.S. government to pressure President Trump into taking actions against the Brazilian government, framing the conflict as a partisan struggle against Lula’s PT. This approach, rooted in the outdated notion that what benefits the U.S. automatically benefits Brazil, is criticized as anachronistic and detrimental to Brazil’s independent foreign policy.

item.title: Grande dia? (por Mary Zaidan)
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated as a 'great day' the U.S. government's designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, following a photo with Trump and Marco Rubio. He framed the move as a personal victory, overlooking potential backlash, especially as Daniel Vorcaro’s renewed talks with the Federal Police threaten to reopen investigations into his family. The article argues this optimism may be premature and could backfire.

item.title: Lideranças do Novo procuraram cúpula do PL para contornar críticas de Zema a Flávio
item.description: Leaders from the Novo party approached the PL's leadership in recent days to ease tensions after Governor Romeu Zema criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, aiming to mitigate the political fallout. The move was reported as an exclusive story for subscribers.

item.title: Congresso debateu e rejeitou equiparar facções criminosas a organizações terroristas
item.description: In February 2026, Brazil's National Congress rejected a proposal to classify criminal factions like the Comando Vermelho and Primeiro Comando da Capital as terrorist organizations, after rapporteur Guilherme Derrite withdrew the clause over national sovereignty concerns. Although the anti-gang bill passed with strong majorities in both chambers, the terrorism equivalence was dropped in the Chamber and never included in the Senate version, with Chamber President Hugo Motta blocking last-minute attempts. The U.S. government, however, designated CV and PCC as terrorist organizations on February 28, following a visit by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to Washington.

item.title: Vasco x Atlético-MG promete duelo com muitos gols; veja e aposte
item.description: Vasco and Atlético-MG face off on Sunday (May 31) at 4 p.m. in São Januário for the 18th round of the Brasileirão, featuring strong attacks and weak defenses. Both teams have high rates of 'both teams score' (59% for Vasco, 55% for Atlético-MG), with odds favoring over 2.5 goals (1.40) and both teams scoring (1.86). Vasco needs a win to avoid the relegation zone before the World Cup break.

item.title: O escândalo passa, a identidade fica
item.description: The Dark Horse scandal reduced Flávio Bolsonaro's support among evangelicals from 49% to 42% (Datafolha), but later polls show he still leads Lula by 54%-57% to 31%-36%, indicating the evangelical base remained resilient. The decline was sharper among moderate right-wing voters, young adults, and in the South, suggesting the impact was segmented and did not dismantle the core identity-based bolsonarist coalition.

item.title: Márcio França deve ficar como vice de Haddad após acordo por vagas ao Senado
item.description: Márcio França is expected to become Fernando Haddad's running mate for governor of São Paulo in 2026, following an agreement that sent Marina Silva and Simone Tebet to run for Senate seats. If Lula wins the 2026 presidential election and Haddad loses the gubernatorial race, França would be appointed to a ministerial position in 2027. The deal resolves the deadlock in forming the Workers' Party ticket in São Paulo.

item.title: Ciro Gomes tenta voltar ao governo do Ceará com um parceiro incômodo
item.description: Ciro Gomes is attempting to return to the governorship of Ceará by forming an alliance with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of the PL, despite his past harsh criticism of the Bolsonaro clan. The strategy leverages local anti-PT sentiment to challenge Governor Elmano de Freitas’s reelection bid, but the alliance causes discomfort given Flávio Bolsonaro’s 60% rejection rate and Lula’s 66% approval in the state. Ciro denies that the alliance signifies endorsement of the national Bolsonarist project, claiming regional politics operates independently, though PL leaders openly celebrate the alliance with the Bolsonaro family, undermining his position.

item.title: Clã Bolsonaro posa de patriota mas entrega o Brasil a Donald Trump
item.description: Ricardo and Guga Noblat criticize the Bolsonaro clan for prioritizing family power over national sovereignty, arguing that their lobbying efforts in the U.S. — led by Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro — paved the way for the Trump administration to label Brazilian factions as terrorist organizations, effectively delivering Brazil to foreign interests under the guise of patriotism.

item.title: Kassab se coloca ‘à disposição’ para ser vice de Caiado, mas diz que definição caberá ao candidato
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, said he is available to be Ronaldo Caiado's running mate in the 2026 elections, but stressed that the final decision on the ticket rests with the candidate and the party. He emphasized that Caiado will have the final say after consulting party instances. The statement comes amid right-wing realignments, as Caiado and Romeu Zema (Novo) discuss a possible alliance, while both trail Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in polls.

item.title: Gleisi chama Moro de “juiz ladrão” em evento eleitoral
item.description: Federal deputy Gleisi Hoffmann (PT) called Senator Sergio Moro (PL) a "thieving judge" during an event in Curitiba launching the pre-candidacy of Requião Filho (PDT) for governor of Paraná. The statement was made in the context of criticizing the far right and the legacy of Operation Car Wash, with Hoffmann asserting that the left will defeat both the right in Brazil and the former judge in the state.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Gleisi Hoffmann accused Flávio Bolsonaro of favoring organized crime, stating that if he genuinely sought to designate the PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, he would have done so during his father Jair Bolsonaro’s government, as both held power for four years without taking such action.

item.title: Os irmãos que estão mandando muito na campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Following the departure of Marcelo Lopes, brothers Nelson and Vicente Santini have gained increased influence in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, becoming central figures in its core team. The article highlights their rising power after Lopes' exit, though full access requires a subscription.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro recebeu dois convites da Casa Branca, mas crise do 'Dark Horse' mudou planos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro received two invitations from the White House for meetings with Donald Trump, including one that occurred last Tuesday and another sent fifteen days prior. However, the crisis involving the 'Dark Horse' group changed his plans, preventing the meetings from taking place. The article is exclusive to subscribers and requires registration for full access.
